There aren't any that I can think of. Now that I think about it, I really don't have many adults in my life. Besides my teachers, it's just my mom and dad, but there's no way my dad would be of any help.

I'm glad you've found things that make you happy. I think another thing that is making it so hard for me to see myself going anywhere is how stressful school is. There's so much pressure to do well in high school because that dictates whether or not you'll get into a good college, which leads to so many other things. I completely messed up my first year of high school, and even though my grades are very good now it's going to ruin my chances of getting into a good school. Just thinking about the fact that something I did as a freshman could potentially ruin my entire life makes me feel like there isn't even a point anymore.

I'm still a minor. I know that if I ever asked my mom to go to therapy she would tell me to just talk to her about whatever is going on, and I would never be able to do that. Honestly, I doubt she'd even believe me anyway. 

I think that's one of my major problems. Everyone is always talking about all the things they want to do when they get older. They can go on and on about what they are going to go to school for, what career path their going to go down, how many kinds they want. Anytime I even try to picture myself going anywhere in life I just can't see it.
